patch_list: Bypass PairIP signature, license & VM gate

Neutralises the PairIP signature and license gates, restores the virtualised lifecycle methods with real Unity delegating bodies, and skips the startup VM program. Required for every other 20 Minutes Till Dawn patch. Credits: fynnaly.

Every shop purchase is granted instantly — no Google Play payment sheet, no real charge. Covers coins, packs, the one-year battle pass and the First Purchase / Ad-Free Forever bundles, which are claimed by tapping Buy once like any other p…
Removes every ad (rewarded, interstitial, app-open, banner, MREC) and grants rewarded-ad rewards instantly — no video ever plays, and no ad can appear anywhere in the game.
